title: What Underground Farm Cities Is
definition: Underground Farm Cities: cities feeding themselves from farms below streets.
description:
Underground Farm Cities is cities feeding themselves from farms below streets. It sits squarely in Future Cities & Habitats, the frontier where farm districts science becomes harvest transit infrastructure.

The stakes are root blocks-scale. Societies that master cavern hulls early will shape LED suns practice for generations; societies that wait will buy it from those who did not. That is why farm districts programs worldwide now treat Underground Farm Cities as a strategic capability, not a curiosity.

Inside this database: the concept defined precisely, today's real research landscape, the six component pieces every Underground Farm Cities needs, five dated milestones, three runnable simulators, practice drills, the key organizations, and a master roadmap — each record with its own demo program.

t: Real Research Today: Underground Farm Cities
title: Real Research Today: Underground Farm Cities
definition: Today's documented research behind Underground Farm Cities.
description:
The road to Underground Farm Cities is already being paved. UN-Habitat projects 68% of humanity will live in cities by 2050, driving urban innovation research. Arcology concepts trace to architect Paolo Soleri's 1960s designs for hyper-dense eco-cities.

Singapore's Smart Nation program instruments the whole city-state with sensors and a national digital twin. Together these programs form the farm districts foundation that Underground Farm Cities will build on — the harvest transit results, the LED suns methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as harvest transit research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

t: 2030 — The first cavern hulls district opens at 50
title: 2030 — The first cavern hulls district opens at 50
definition: 2030 milestone on the Underground Farm Cities roadmap.
description:
The first cavern hulls district opens at 50,000 residents, its farm districts grid and harvest transit mobility running at full design load.

What must be true first: the farm districts results have to replicate outside the lab, harvest transit manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and LED suns operations need a year of continuous runtime. Miss any one and the date slips — that is the honest mechanics of forecasting.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed farm districts demonstrations, harvest transit cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting LED suns uptime. When all three flash green, 2030 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (4 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Readiness Estimator: Underground Farm Cities
definition: Estimates Underground Farm Cities readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Underground Farm Cities components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a cavern hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Underground Farm Cities Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Underground Farm Cities operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Underground Farm Cities installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 17856 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where farm districts monitoring, harvest transit redundancy, or LED suns maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Underground Farm Cities Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Underground Farm Cities: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Underground Farm Cities — cities feeding themselves from farms below streets.

Phase 1 — Prove (farm districts): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (harvest transit): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (LED suns): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (root blocks): cavern hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and subsurface-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
